reencounter.settingHelp: Gently mark saved expressions and compare new and saved sentences. Off by default; no automatic AI requests or review changes.
reencounter.title: Meet it again
reencounter.readFailed: Unable to load this saved expression. Please retry.
reencounter.noSentence: This expression has no saved example sentence.
reencounter.setup: Set up AI and sentence context
reencounter.requestScope: Requested explanations use this expression and its current sentence. Enabled learning memory follows your AI settings; saved card references and source URLs are not sent.
reencounter.contextDisabled: Sentence context is disabled. Enable it in selection translation to explain this usage.
reencounter.question: Explain this expression in the current sentence, citing the sentence as evidence and noting ambiguity.
reencounter.unsupported: Saved-expression marking requires the browser extension; userscripts are not supported.
